sentences.sentence: The aim of this work was to identify the chemical compounds produced by *C. nivalis* that may be responsible for the pink color of snow algae.

By using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) and retention time alignment, we were able to identify three esterified derivatives of the carotenoid astaxanthin, all of which are new to science.
These are astaxanthin diglucoside mono-ester (1), astaxanthin diglucoside di-ester (2), and astaxanthin diglucoside tri-ester (3).

We found that esterification can occur between the hydroxyl groups of both ends of the carotenois aglycon or between one of the hydroxyl groups of both ends with the free hydroxyl group of a glucoside.
The results indicate that the three identified ester derivatives have a similar retention time, and it was not possible to separate them by liquid chromatography.

Therefore, only the molecular formulas were determined by liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) with atmospheric pressure chemical ionization, and the structures of the compounds were confirmed using tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS).
The proposed chemical structures of astaxanthin diglucoside mono-ester and astaxanthin diglucoside di-ester were further verified by synthesis.
The results provide new information about the secondary metabolites produced by *C.

sentences.sentence: factors that influence expert's opinions about software project effective risk management.
This research is an exploratory study to examine the expert’s opinions about software project effective risk management.
This study aims to identify how the experts perceive the effective risk management practices used in software projects.
The research was conducted in order to have a better understanding of what expert's opinion about the effective risk management in the software projects.
This is a qualitative study, which included semi-structured interviews with seven experts from the software industry.
These were expert practitioners having at least five years of professional experience in their field.
The results indicate that the experts agreed on some factors such as; planning, identifying, analyzing, and responding to risks, but they had different views on other factors.
The experts have agreed that the project manager should be responsible for managing the risk.
In addition, the expert agreed that communication and documentation are very important.
The experts had different views about the importance of software development life cycle for the effective risk management.
Some experts agreed that software development life cycle plays an important role in the effective risk management, while the others had different view on this.

From the findings we can conclude that there are a number of factors that influence expert's opinions on software project effective risk management and these factors should be taken into consideration when planning the software project.

In particular, this paper is based on the review of literature, analysis of secondary data, and case study research methods.
To investigate the problem in question, a questionnaire was distributed to 1200 facilities management (FM) firms from Europe, Asia, North America, and South America.
852 responses were received.
After screening the questionnaires, 498 were valid and used in the analysis.
The data were analysed using multiple regression techniques.
The findings have been reported using tables and figures.
Findings – The results show that there is a significant relationship between the use of internal procurement route and the ongoing buyer-supplier relationship.
There is also a significant relationship between the use of external procurement route and the ongoing buyer-supplier relationship.
Furthermore, the effect of the use of the internal procurement route on the buyer-supplier relationship is more significant than the effect of the external procurement route.
Research limitations/implications – This study has only taken into account one kind of procurement routes.
Future studies could consider more factors which influence the buyer-supplier relationship.
For example, the impact of procurement price, the impact of procurement quality and the impact of procurement time.
Practical implications – In the process of facility management (FM), managers should pay attention to the selection of procurement route.
By selecting appropriate procurement route, we can get the good ongoing buyer-supplier relationship.

Originality/value – This research provides useful information and insights regarding the impact of the use of internal procurement route or external procurement route on the buyer-supplier relationship.
